title: Cute, bright colors
text:
Cute, bright colors. This is cute and bright colors. It stands alone, but looks wrinkled. I know this is so that it can collapse, but for $25, I think I would prefer a laundry basket that is firm. I don't think it's a good value for the money. It's ok. I would think this shouldn't sell for more the $15.

It is cute and will be used in my daughter's bathroom for her laundry.
